source_clauses.verbatim: Design a foot pedal for a workbench.
Pressing it should send a signal to the machine
and when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own every time.
It should not move if something brushes against it sideways.

requirements.statement_verbatim: Design a foot pedal for a workbench.
requirements.observable_verbatim: A foot pedal is designed for a workbench.

requirements.statement_verbatim: Pressing it should send a signal to the machine
requirements.observable_verbatim: When the pedal is pressed, a signal is sent to the machine.

requirements.statement_verbatim: and when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own every time.
requirements.observable_verbatim: When the foot is removed, the pedal returns to its resting position on its own every time.

requirements.statement_verbatim: It should not move if something brushes against it sideways.
requirements.observable_verbatim: When something brushes against the pedal sideways, it does not move.

scenarios.name: Pedal operation
scenarios.system_boundary: The foot pedal and the machine it signals.

scenarios.name: Pedal service
scenarios.system_boundary: The foot pedal in its installed state.

scenarios.name: Pedal assembly
scenarios.system_boundary: The foot pedal as a product to be assembled.

freedoms.decision: The exact dimensions, materials, and mechanisms of the pedal are not specified.
freedoms.why_free: The text does not mention any specific dimensions, materials, or mechanisms.

freedoms.decision: The type of signal and its transmission to the machine are not specified.
freedoms.why_free: The text only says 'send a signal' without specifying the signal type or transmission method.

ambiguities.statement: What constitutes 'moving' when something brushes against it sideways? Does any displacement count, or only significant movement?
ambiguities.resolvable_when: During design review or testing, precise movement tolerances can be defined.
block_scopes: Design of the pedal's lateral stability

ambiguities.statement: What is the definition of 'every time'? Does it mean always without exception, or under normal conditions?
ambiguities.resolvable_when: During acceptance testing, criteria for reliable return can be established.

assumptions.statement: The foot pedal is intended for use by an operator at a workbench.
assumptions.why: The text says 'for a workbench' and refers to 'I' as the user.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: A different context of use described in future requirements.

assumptions.statement: The machine is separate from the pedal and receives the signal.
assumptions.why: The text says 'send a signal to the machine'.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: An explicit statement that the pedal is integrated into the machine.
